retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast psychedelic collage featuring a large, white-line-art portrait of a bearded man juxtaposed against vibrant rainbow arcs and surreal landscape elements.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex visual composition where a large, stylized black-and-white line-art head with a flowing, rhythmic beard dominates the right side, while the left side is filled with a dense, colorful collage of rainbows, clouds, strawberries, and distorted hand-lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome portrait vs. saturated multi-color background
Rhythmic, flowing lines of the beard echoing the curves of the rainbow
Distorted, vertically stretched typography integrated into the landscape
Surreal scale shifts between small figures and large fruit elements
coreInvariants: The beard must be composed of continuous, parallel, rhythmic black lines on a white ground.
A multi-colored concentric rainbow arc must serve as a central structural element.
Typography must be vertically elongated and follow a curved or warped path.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large-scale portrait occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, extending from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast black-and-white face of the bearded man.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, follows the flowing lines of the beard downward, then moves left into the colorful landscape and upward along the rainbow arc to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and 'horror vacui' in nature, with dark purple filling the remaining corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple background providing a dark base for the collage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white and black for the linear portrait.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant spectrum of red, orange, yellow, green, and blue in the rainbow and landscape.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the collage elements contrasts with the zero-saturation monochrome portrait.
paletteRestrictions: Primary and secondary colors must be highly saturated

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke widths with heavy vertical stems
Curvilinear baselines following the arc of the rainbow
Interlocking or tightly packed character spacing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'S' and 'R' feature exaggerated, flowing tails
Vertical stems are stretched to 3-4 times their standard height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom-lettering style used for all text to maintain psychedelic consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the authentic 1960s psychedelic poster aesthetic.
Provides the organic, flowing skeleton for the letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a psychedelic collage with a deep purple background. On the right, a large white-line-art portrait of a man with a long, flowing, rhythmic beard. On the left, a vibrant landscape with a multi-colored rainbow arc, stylized clouds, and oversized strawberries.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text following the curve of the rainbow arc. The letters should be white, extremely vertically elongated, and styled with Art Nouveau curves.

verificationChecks: Is the beard composed of rhythmic, parallel black lines?
Is the text vertically stretched and following a curve?
Is there a high contrast between the monochrome portrait and the colorful background?

adjustableVariables: Number of colors in the rainbow arc
Degree of vertical stretch in the typography
mustRedesign: Do not use standard modern fonts
Do not use realistic photographic textures for the face

mustAchieve: Rhythmic line quality in the hair
Vibrant, saturated color palette in the collage
Fluid integration of text and graphics

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the beard lines do not blur into a solid gray mass.
Check that the rainbow colors are distinct and saturated.
Verify the text is legible despite the extreme vertical distortion.
Confirm the portrait remains the primary visual anchor.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast linear subject with a saturated, surrealist collage background and vertically warped Art Nouveau lettering.
